view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. Red metal shelving units line both sides of an aisle, stocked with boxes and pallets. Yellow safety barriers and identification tags are visible. The floor is concrete, and various storage items are scattered around, including stacked cardboard boxes and plastic-wrapped goods.

objects.label: red metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall red metal shelves on the right side of the aisle, filled with boxes and wrapped materials. Yellow identification tags like 'AA 09' are attached. Supported by yellow protective barriers at base. Partially occluded by other shelves and items in foreground.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow metal barriers placed along the base of the red shelving units on the right. They appear freestanding and serve as protection. Positioned directly under shelves, supporting no load but defining aisle boundaries.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Stacked cardboard boxes on wooden pallets near left aisle. Some are open, others sealed. Located on concrete floor, partially occluding view of shelving behind. No visible supports except for pallets.

objects.label: plastic-wrapped goods
objects.observation: Large bundles wrapped in clear plastic, stored on pallets near right-side shelves. Positioned against shelves, supported by pallets. Occluded by nearby shelving and barriers.

objects.label: fluorescent light fixtures
objects.observation: Long rectangular fluorescent lights mounted to ceiling. Illuminate entire space evenly. Visible above shelves and aisles. Not occluded by any objects.

objects.label: blue identification sign
objects.observation: Blue vertical sign with white text 'BA 14' attached to left-side shelving unit. Positioned near top of shelf. Clearly visible against background. Attached to metal frame of shelving.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36764", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
